defs.def: making a lot of noise 吵闹的；聒噪的；嘈杂的

ex.s: It’s affordable, and it’s got a fun atmosphere without being too noisy.
ex.t: 它价格实惠，氛围有趣又不太吵。

ex.s: A film-making centre means the town will get very noisy and crowded.
ex.t: 一个电影制作中心意味着这个镇子会变得非常嘈杂和拥挤。

ex.s: Over the empty streets-over the forum- far and wide-with many a noisy crash in the stormy sea-fell that awful shower!
ex.t: 那可怕的阵雨，越过空旷的街道，越过广场，在暴风雨的海面上发出许多嘈杂的撞击声，到处散落！

ex.s: A small boy walked past with a group of noisy goats as I took a long look at the yellow roadside sign that told us we were entering a "fragile natural environment".
ex.t: 一个小男孩带着一群吵闹的山羊走过，我们久久地注视着黄色的路牌，上面告诉我们正进入一个＂脆弱的自然环境＂。

defs.def: full of noise 充满噪音的；吵吵闹闹的

ex.s: Li Zhen: I'm notreallyamusicfan.Inparticular, I3 rock music because it's so noisy.I can't stand it!
ex.t: 李珍：我并不是一个真正的音乐迷。特别是，我3______摇滚乐，因为它太吵了。我受不了！
